主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on January 11, 2018. The filing includes Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, which are a Preliminary Term Sheet dated January 11, 2018, and a Press release dated January 11, 2018. The filing is related to the Registration Statement of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. and Brookfield Finance Inc. on Form F-10 (File Nos. 333-220746 and 333-220746-01). The report was signed by A.J. Silber, Vice President, Legal Affairs and Corporate Secretary, on behalf of the registrant on January 11, 2018.
